Verified/approx rendered per card (the wire already carries them); the verification ledger must verify the pack that was actually built - wire item 4 in section 4: either VerifyContextRequest gains cards/intent or verification moves into GetContextPack's response, pick with a stated reason. stages.notes: STRAND DOC: docs/dev/research/DESKTOP-PRODUCT-AUDIT-2026-08-13.md section 4 (the shopping list, items 1-4) and section 5 M7 - the no-decision subset only; the Reader itself is owner-refinement work and OUT of this run. stages.title: Loop joints - routes into Studio + repo-file hand-off (owner decision 3)
stages.notes: STRAND DOC: docs/dev/research/STUDIO-MCP-AUDIT-2026-08-13.md sections 4 (Room 1) and 5 N3; section 8 decision 3. Send-to-Studio from Explore (selection, trail, pins), Insights cards, and NodeCard. Studio default state = the current trail plus pins rendered as a PROPOSED pack - never opens empty after exploration; archetype preset on a fresh session. Hand-off is REPO FILE FIRST: Save writes .devcontext/packs/<slug>.md (gitignored by default) plus a copyable point-your-agent-here line for CLAUDE.md; Home's point-your-agent-here routes THROUGH Studio. Server-registered packs are explicitly deferred - do not build SavePack.

stages.title: MCP page rebuild - the observation deck (owner decision 4: full deck + ship binary)
stages.notes: STRAND DOC: docs/dev/research/STUDIO-MCP-AUDIT-2026-08-13.md sections 4 (Room 2 + wire items 1-3) and 5 N4; section 8 decision 4. PRECONDITION: the engine run's T1 (curated described catalog) should be reachable - merge feat/pre-release-engine into this branch first and record the merge in the handoff; if T1 has not landed yet, deliver N4.1 and N4.2 and leave N4.3 open rather than rendering the pre-curation soup. Status must MEASURE: binary fs probe, ObserverCount + last-agent-call-at on the wire, a handshake that runs one real MCP tools/list round-trip; Start/Stop is killed or renamed to what it does (a global telemetry mute is a trap). Ship devcontext-mcp in the Tauri bundle so the page's existing claim becomes true; snippets carry the resolved absolute path; write-config-for-me per host. Feed keyed by MCP tool names (analyze wrapped and visible, args digest restored, wire timestamps); rows deep-link - trace into Explore, get_context into replay-in-Studio.

stages.title: Close-out: docs + backlog + README screenshot sync, full battery, push
stages.notes: STRAND DOC: docs/dev/research/PRE-RELEASE-PLAN-2026-08-13.md sections 3 and 6-7. Reconcile STUDIO-MCP-AUDIT statuses, DECISIONS.md (D-G settled by N2 - say so), BUG-BACKLOG.md; update the PRE-RELEASE-PLAN stage table for this run. Then the README screenshot sync (Z1.2): this run rebuilt Studio and the MCP page, so docs/screenshots is stale - refresh via the EXISTING capture pipeline (src/DevContext.App/scripts/screenshot-readme.mts or capture-readme.mts; restart start-dev-bg.ps1 first per trap 5; run long captures via conductor bg start). At minimum 08-context-studio, 09-export, 10-mcp, plus any page this run visibly changed; update README captions where the UI changed but do NOT touch the README's agent-story claims (the engine run's Z1 owns those). GitHub sync of tracker + report happens continuously via report.push - add no extra sync machinery. Leave the tree clean and pushed. Merging to develop is owner-signed and NOT this stage's job.

promptExtra:
TRAPS THIS PROGRAM HAS ALREADY PAID FOR - do not rediscover them:
1. A backtick inside an HTML comment TERMINATES an Angular template literal. This has fired three times. Worse, pnpm ng build piped through grep for error markers looks CLEAN because esbuild emits ANSI colour codes before the failure marker. CHECK the exit code, never the filtered output. Write field names in comments without backticks.
2. Every node scripts/... command needs an absolute cd in the SAME command - a drifted working directory has cost this program two sessions.
3. Rebuild src/DevContext.Cli after ANY Core edit - the CLI carries its own DevContext.Core.dll (stale-dll trap).
4. A proto change means rebuilding DevContext.Contracts AND pnpm gen:proto, wiring server + app in lockstep.
5. Restart src/DevContext.App/scripts/start-dev-bg.ps1 before any Playwright capture that follows a build; a stale vite-error-overlay silently eats clicks.
6. MEASURE a verdict, do not read it off a doc comment. This audit's own file:line claims are dated 2026-08-13 - re-verify before editing.
7. Never weaken a measurement to get green: no deleted tests, no relaxed expectations, no softened gate. If a bar is genuinely wrong, escalate via the tracker handoff and stop.
8. Never merge to develop. That is an owner-signed event.
9. If node_modules is missing in this worktree, run pnpm install under src/DevContext.App first; if eval-repos submodules are empty, git submodule update --init first.
10. Long child processes (e2e suites, batch captures) run via conductor bg start --purpose <label> -- <cmd> so the watchdog sees a live child.

deliver.name: deliver
deliver.description: Deliver until the stage's checkpoints are confirmed. Conductor's battery is the QA; no separate verify session.
